newsitem.title: USA: US NASD names Frank Zarb as new president and CEO.
newsitem.headline: US NASD names Frank Zarb as new president and CEO.

text.p: Frank Zarb, former chairman of Alexander & Alexander Services, will be the new president and chief executive officer of the National Association of Securities Dealers, NASD said Tuesday.

Zarb will assume his new duties on February 24, succeeding Joseph Hardiman, who is retiring on January 31 after nearly 10 years of service to the self-regulatory group that runs the Nasdaq stock market.

The selection of Zarb ended a search that began in early July, 1996, when a committee was formed by NASD chair Daniel Tully, who is also chairman and chief executive officer of Merrill Lynch & Co Inc.

"The Board of Governors believes that with his proven leadership abilities and vast experience in both the private and public sectors, Frank is the ideal person to lead the NASD in its next phase of growth and development," Tully said in a statement.
Alexander & Alexander, based in New York, is a major insurance services and human resources consulting firm. The company was recently acquired by Chicago-based insurance giant Aon Corp.
